item.title: Miles de árboles limoneros en España viven una crisis histórica: el virus que ha puesto en jaque a toda la industria
item.description: Su nombre quizás no te diga gran cosa, pero el virus de la clorosis nervial amarilla (CYVCV por sus siglas en inglés) supone desde hace meses un auténtico dolor de muelas para los agricultores que se dedican a cultivar cítricos. Uno más que se suma a las fluctuaciones de producción y precios. El motivo es simple: tras expandirse por varios países durante las últimas cuatro décadas, el CYVCV llegó a España en 2025 con su amenaza de arruinar el fruto de miles de limoneros. Y eso es un problema en la gran huerta de cítricos de la UE. Cinco letras: CYVCV . En España lleva solo unos meses… Fuente: Xataka.

item.title: Indian-American CEO who sacked 900 over Zoom gets fired himself
item.description: Indian-American entrepreneur Vishal Garg has been ousted as Better Home & Finance CEO. The company cited concerns about his judgment and credibility after significant losses. Garg's removal follows his controversial 2021 mass layoff of 900 employees. He is now seeking to regain his position and is offering to work for one dollar annually. Better's market value has significantly decreased since its pandemic-era peak. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: 266 days deployed: USS Abraham Lincoln to return home amid rising scrutiny over sailor welfare
item.description: After an extended deployment, the USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier is making its way home. While Acting Navy Secretary Hung Cao minimized reports of sailor difficulties and supply deficiencies, the Navy contends that allegations regarding a mental health crisis aboard are overstated. This lengthy deployment highlights the pressures faced by the US Navy's carrier fleet, with the USS George Washington set to take over its operations in the Middle East. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Cheap travel is not a defence’: the parents facing court for school absences in England
item.description: In one court in Kent, most cases relate to term-time holidays, but non-attendance is a complex issue and post-pandemic rates remain high As the long school summer break approached its mid-point recently, Margate beach was crowded with families enjoying the brief reprieve between the year’s fourth and fifth heatwaves. For most, thoughts of the classroom were probably not at the forefront of their minds. But for the seven mothers and two fathers who were summoned at 10am to a stuffy room in the town’s magistrates court, set just behind the beachfront strip of arcades, the subject was… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.description: At least 19 elephants have died since June in a popular wildlife region of southern Kenya, with the local toll now reported at 20. Early tests have suggested cyanide poisoning from pesticides, but wildlife experts say the evidence does not fit all the symptoms they have observed. Fuente: Euronews.
